contract.task_clause:
When teaching a patient inhaler technique, how will you ensure that a large proportion of the drug reaches the lower airways?
Option A: Ask them to take lots of small, quick breaths in before using the inhaler.
Option B: Ask them to breathe normally when using the inhaler.
Option C: Ask them to perform the procedure as quickly as they can.
Option D: Ask them to hold their breath at the end of the inspiration on using the inhaler.
